newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor Q1 cons net 3.4 bln esc vs 2.2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor Q1 cons net 3.4 bln esc vs 2.2 bln.

text.p: NOTE: Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal is a leading Portuguese cement company. It said in a statement that sales of cement in the first quarter 1996 were hit by bad weather, unlike in the first quarter of 1997.

Cimpor's consolidated operating margin rose to 17.2 percent in the first quarter, almost double the 9.5 percent registered in the same year-ago period, the company said. At the end of March 1997, Cimpor's capital stood at 201 billion escudos, 8.3 percent above that posted in the same year-ago period. Sales of cement by Cimpor grew by 26.4 percent in Portugal, 3.2 percent in Spain, 23.2 percent in Morocco and 15.4 percent in Mozambique.
